The 2028 US Presidential Election is scheduled to take place on November 7, 2028.

This market will resolve to the person who wins the 2028 US Presidential Election.

The resolution source for this market is the Associated Press, Fox News, and NBC. This market will resolve once all three sources call the race for the same candidate. If all three sources haven’t called the race for the same candidate by the inauguration date (January 20, 2029) this market will resolve based on who is inaugurated.

eventMetadata.context_description: Vice President JD Vance leads 2028 presidential nomination markets at 21.4% amid his current role and reported private backing from President Trump, while Secretary of State Marco Rubio sits at 12.4% as he differentiates on foreign policy, including approaches to Iran. On the Democratic side, early positioning among figures such as Gavin Newsom, Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, and Jon Ossoff reflects a wide-open primary with no dominant frontrunner two years before voting begins. Recent polls show narrowing gaps in hypothetical Republican matchups, and 2026 midterm outcomes for Senate and House control remain key variables. Trader consensus stays tight because structural factors like primary calendars, fundraising trajectories, and shifting voter coalitions have yet to produce separation, with late developments in party messaging or candidate positioning likely to drive future movement.
